highlights: Row across from the mended landing: forage the woods, camp by the fire, fish the Hollow Pool after dark, and help Bramwell relight his lantern.
Every Lanternday, 5 to 7 PM: fish against Marlo, Dottie, Ferris and Old Hen for ribbons, coins and a cup.
On a controller, the d-pad jumps the pointer straight to the next card, button or bed in windows.
Slimmer festival, club and expedition cards, one note at a time, and a radio that stays small until it speaks.
Swapping shells with Kit now spreads the cost across your spares, plus other small fixes.
notes: The Far Shore: once the old landing is mended, row across to the woods on the other side. Gather wild finds that change with the seasons (they cook into dishes and sell), meet Bramwell the forest ranger and help him with a favour a day, roast supper or brew tea at the campfire, sleep in the tent, and fish the Hollow Pool after dark for five new fish with their own journal page. Mend and light the old Hollow Lantern and the Hollow King starts to bite.

The Angling Club meets every Lanternday from 5 to 7 PM. Fish anywhere on the lake against four regulars (biggest fish one week, most species the next) while the board moves through the evening. Ribbons for the top three, a cup for a win, and a letter from your rival Marlo after every meet.
Controllers: in windows with a pointer (the Trading Post, garden, hatchery, journal, cabin) the d-pad now snaps the pointer to the nearest thing in that direction, and holding it keeps stepping.

A calmer Clean HUD: the festival, club and expedition cards are one slim line (point at them for more), notes come one at a time with a small count of what's waiting, and the radio is a small pill that opens up when the host speaks. Notes over a window are one slim line above it instead of covering its title.

A tidier journal: the five fish pages are chips along the top showing how many you've found at each, tiles size themselves to the page, the fish card shows its record, count and price at a glance, and a bold W no longer looks like an N.
A What's new card after each update, four new badges, and fixes: swapping shells with Kit spreads the cost across your spare shells instead of taking them all from one kind, plus other small fixes.
